thread.text:
Most browser driving games fake drifting with a lazy `car.friction *= 0.5` handbrake key.

We built Drift around authentic weight-transfer physics in raw Canvas: tap the brakes to load the front axle, pitch the rear loose, and catch the slide purely with countersteer and throttle.
thread.mediaNote: High-framerate gameplay GIF showing a smooth, high-angle weight-transfer slide through a rainy biome transition into a tight corner.

thread.text:
Because you're piloting an EV, dynamics and energy economy are linked:

• Off-road turf drains your battery 90x faster
• Regenerative braking tightens your turn radius while harvesting juice back into the pack
• Need a top-up? Slide straight into rest-area DC fast chargers.
thread.mediaNote: Short clip highlighting the telemetry HUD showing battery regen kick in during a braking drift, followed by a quick recharge slide into a charging bay.

thread.text:
Zero audio files were downloaded for this.

The entire EV powertrain soundscape is synthesized live via the WebAudio API:
• Pitch tracks wheel RPM
• Loudness maps directly to instantaneous |kW| draw
• Regen braking triggers a procedural reverse-harmonic whine in real time.
thread.mediaNote: Video snippet with audio on showcasing the procedural EV motor pitch bending under heavy acceleration vs regenerative braking.

thread.text:
No build steps. No node_modules. No frameworks.

Just pure vanilla JS, procedural biome generation, deterministic daily seeded ghost racing, and 60fps canvas rendering packed inside a single self-contained HTML file that boots in under 100ms.
